summary: Implemented frontend Gizmo built-in `display` tool rendering using @json-render/core and @json-render/svelte 0.20.0. Created DisplayElement.svelte (catalog component renderers) and DisplayResult.svelte (wraps Renderer + JsonUIProvider with derived spec), integrated into ToolCallCard with inline rendering for running/partial and completed results, with normal fallback for invalid/error results. Added tests/lib/features/conversation/display.test.ts covering all catalog components, escaped malicious text, invalid results, and inline collapsed/running behavior. svelte-check and tests now pass after wrapping Renderer in JsonUIProvider to supply missing state context.
decisions: Display output renders inline (outside collapsed <details>) for both running partial results and completed results; no expanding required by the user.
Use a static typed catalog with allowed components Heading{level 1-3}, Text, Card, Stack, List, Table, Metric, Divider; static props only, no computed values.
Use the real @json-render/svelte Renderer + a local fixed ComponentRegistry/snippet registry instead of dumping raw spec params; theme styles applied via registry CSS classes.
Wrap Renderer in JsonUIProvider so getStateContext and related contexts resolve (fixed the 'must be called within a StateProvider' test failures).
Normalize the spec via a $derived clone so json-render's strict UIElement type accepts it, then bind to <Renderer>.
Invalid/missing display results fall back to existing tool fallback error rendering (pre/code or empty state) rather than crashing.
Tests added covering each catalog component, escaped malicious text (no HTML injection), invalid envelope falling back to error path, and inline rendering across running/collapsed/complete states.
Files kept under 300 lines per requirement; no commit performed.
errors: svelte-check initially reported 2 errors: DisplayResult.svelte Spec type incompatibility (Stack props 'object' not assignable to Record<string, unknown>) and DisplayElement.svelte a11y_no_noninteractive_tabindex on the table-scroll div; resolved by normalizing spec via $derived spread and adding a svelte-ignore comment with a keyboard-scroll rationale.

vitest run failed with 'getStateContext must be called within a StateProvider' thrown from Renderer.svelte for 6 display tests; resolved by wrapping the Renderer in JsonUIProvider in DisplayResult.svelte. After fix, all 12 display tests and the broader 226-test suite pass, and svelte-check passes.
